How to play EternalBliss

Explore

Use WASD or the arrow keys, drag the circular joystick, or click a land tile to walk there. Use Space or Enter, tap a nearby character, or tap Interact. Press Escape to dismiss help or a conversation.

Use the minimap’s + and − buttons to change its zoom. Tap Local to see the entire world. Tap World to follow your hero again.

Travel

Shops sell boats for 50 gold and pickaxes for 75 gold. A boat gives 15 moves on water. A pickaxe clears 10 mountains. Keys open doors. Teleport costs 25 gold.

Fight and recover

Approach an enemy to attack. Magic uses mana. Health potions, inn rests and temple blessings restore your hero. Items on the ground are collected when you walk over them.

Playing together and saving

Choose Shared world to sign in. You can use your Magic Over name and passphrase here. In the shared world, use Duel to invite another player or join with a code. Solo adventures save automatically on this device.

Leaderboard

Ranked by level, then XP, enemies defeated and treasures found.
